  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (n == 0) then 0 else if (R((n - 1)) > n) then (R((n - 1)) - n) else (R((n - 1)) + n)))

  effects pure
  example (R(0) == 0)
  example (R(1) == 1)
